name: vetmybuilder-e2e-tests
description: Playwright E2E/API test framework for VetMyBuilder

scripts.test:api: playwright test tests/api --project shard-1 --project shard-2 --project shard-3 --project shard-4
scripts.test:api:headed: playwright test tests/api --headed --project shard-1 --project shard-2 --project shard-3 --project shard-4
scripts.test:ui:desktop: PW_HEADLESS=0 playwright test -c playwright.ui.config.ts tests/ui --project ui-desktop-chromium --project ui-desktop-firefox --project ui-desktop-webkit
scripts.test:ui:mobile: PW_HEADLESS=0 playwright test -c playwright.ui.config.ts tests/ui --project ui-mobile-chromium-android --project ui-mobile-chromium-iphone --project ui-mobile-webkit-iphone
scripts.test:ui:chromium: PW_HEADLESS=0 playwright test -c playwright.ui.config.ts tests/ui --project ui-desktop-chromium
scripts.test:ui:firefox: PW_HEADLESS=0 playwright test -c playwright.ui.config.ts tests/ui --project ui-desktop-firefox
scripts.test:ui:webkit: PW_HEADLESS=0 playwright test -c playwright.ui.config.ts tests/ui --project ui-desktop-webkit
scripts.test:ui:mobile:chromium: PW_HEADLESS=0 playwright test -c playwright.ui.config.ts tests/ui --project ui-mobile-chromium-android
scripts.test:ui:mobile:webkit: PW_HEADLESS=0 playwright test -c playwright.ui.config.ts tests/ui --project ui-mobile-webkit-iphone
